system.description:
Whenever you make an attack that causes a Vehicle to move -1 or more steps down the Condition Track, you may also cause it to lose one of the following systems: Hyperdrive, one Weapon System or Weapon Battery, or communications.

The system remains inoperable until the target regains all steps on the Condition Track.

prerequisite.text: Expert Gunner talent, and System Hit talent
